requirements.text: Notification types and their allowed channels are declared; unknown types and channels are rejected and defaults apply
Preferences are read and saved only for the server-resolved user and tenant
Concurrent edits cannot silently overwrite each other; identical retries are harmless
Malformed structure, identity fields, wrong content type and oversized bodies are refused without writing
An accessible form edits each type and channel and announces the save result
Every sender checks the preference before using a channel, while mandatory security notices still go out
Emails carry a one-click unsubscribe that updates the matching preference

evidence.name: schemas reject duplicate, unsafe, and undeclared configuration
authenticated GET and PUT persist preferences only for the server-resolved identity
missing/denied origins and identities never reach persistence
simultaneous differing updates from one revision permit only one saved result
identical retries do not increment revision
invalid preference structure, identity fields, content type, and oversized JSON do not write
React form saves the selected channel, disables in-flight edits, and announces success

implementations.notes: No production store; enforcement at send time and unsubscribe links are out of scope
